instruction: How to configure Argo to use a MySQL database for archival
output:
kubectl patch configmap workflow-controller-configmap -n argo --type merge -p '{"data":{"persistence":"mysql:
  host: mysql
  port: 3306
  database: argo
  tableName: argo_workflows
  userNameSecret:
    name: argo-mysql-config
    key: username
  passwordSecret:
    name: argo-mysql-config
    key: password"}}'

instruction: How to configure Argo to use a PostgreSQL database for archival
output:
kubectl patch configmap workflow-controller-configmap -n argo --type merge -p '{"data":{"persistence":"postgresql:
  host: postgres
  port: 5432
  database: argo
  tableName: argo_workflows
  userNameSecret:
    name: argo-postgres-config
    key: username
  passwordSecret:
    name: argo-postgres-config
    key: password"}}'

instruction: How to enable workflow GC for completed workflows
output: kubectl patch configmap workflow-controller-configmap -n argo --type merge -p '{"data":{"workflowGarbageCollector":"enabled: true"}}'

instruction: How to enable workflow progress reporting
output: kubectl patch configmap workflow-controller-configmap -n argo --type merge -p '{"data":{"progress":"enabled: true"}}'

instruction: How to enable workflow resource counting
output: kubectl patch configmap workflow-controller-configmap -n argo --type merge -p '{"data":{"resourceCounter":"enabled: true"}}'

instruction: How to enable workflow metrics
output: kubectl patch configmap workflow-controller-configmap -n argo --type merge -p '{"data":{"metricsConfig":"enabled: true\npath: /metrics"}}'
